pr_title: feat: show diff tab by default
pr_body:
Close https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/19803

I had to manually inject `window.playwrightReportBase64` data into `playwright/packages/html-reporter/index.html` when developing, wondering if there's any method I don't know.
pr_comments: The CI failure doesn't seem related to the changes.
Over to @pavelfeldman since this is a UX-related change.
Thank you for the PR, merging in!

issue_context.title: [Feature] select `diff` by default when it's available
issue_context.body: When using html-reporter for visual testing, I would love to check `diff` view first when it's available, Which means I can tell the difference between Actual and Expected at the first sight. Selecting Actual in the beginning isn't helpful IMO. Let me know if you would accept a pull request for it.
comments: This looks reasonable to me. Feel free to submit a PR!

review_comments:
According to https://github.com/gildas-lormeau/zip.js/tree/master/dist:

Instead, import index.js in the root folder of the project or one of the files prefixed with zip- in the [/lib](https://github.com/gildas-lormeau/zip.js/blob/master/lib) folder (e.g. /lib/zip-no-worker-inflate.js).
